mapper.select: WITH LATEST_PBLNT AS ( SELECT MAX(pblnt_sn) AS pblnt_sn FROM kids_own.tb_cm_m_uld_pblnt WHERE del_yn = 'N' ) SELECT /* kr.or.kids.domain.cm.community.dashboard.mapper.selectCdmDataStats */ COALESCE(SUM(H.uld_nocs), 0) AS uldNocs , ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(H.err_rt, 0) / 100.0 * COALESCE(H.uld_nocs, 0))) AS errNocs , ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(H.err_rt, 0) * COALESCE(H.uld_nocs, 0)) / NULLIF(SUM(H.uld_nocs), 0), 2) AS errRt FROM kids_own.tb_cm_m_uld_pblnt PB JOIN LATEST_PBLNT L ON PB.pblnt_sn = L.pblnt_sn LEFT JOIN kids_own.tb_cm_m_uld_prst P ON P.pblnt_sn = L.pblnt_sn AND P.del_yn = 'N' LEFT JOIN kids_own.tb_pp_m_inst I ON I.brno = P.inst_id AND I.del_yn = 'N' LEFT JOIN kids_own.tb_cm_e_tbl_uld_stats_hist H ON H.ptcp_inst_sn = P.ptcp_inst_sn AND H.pblnt_sn = L.pblnt_sn AND H.del_yn = 'N'

SELECT /* kr.or.kids.domain.cm.community.dashboard.mapper.selectPblntPrgrStats */ COUNT(*) AS totalCnt , COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE pblnt_prgrs_stts_cd = '01') AS reqCnt -- 등록 , COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE pblnt_prgrs_stts_cd = '02') AS progressCnt -- 진행중 , COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE pblnt_prgrs_stts_cd = '03') AS closeCnt -- 마감 FROM kids_own.tb_cm_m_uld_pblnt WHERE (del_yn IS NULL OR del_yn = 'N')

SELECT /* kr.or.kids.domain.cm.community.dashboard.mapper.selectTbCmMAsmt */ COUNT(*) AS totalCnt -- 총계 , COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN A.asmt_prgrs_stts_cd = '01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS reqCnt -- 등록(참여요청) , COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN A.asmt_prgrs_stts_cd = '02' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS progressCnt -- 진행중 , COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN A.asmt_prgrs_stts_cd = '03' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS reviewCnt -- 검토중 , COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN A.asmt_prgrs_stts_cd = '04' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS closeCnt -- 마감 , COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN A.asmt_prgrs_stts_cd = '05' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS cancelCnt -- 취소 FROM kids_own.tb_cm_m_asmt A WHERE A.del_yn = 'N'

WITH LATEST_PBLNT AS ( SELECT MAX(pblnt_sn) AS pblnt_sn FROM kids_own.tb_cm_m_uld_pblnt WHERE del_yn = 'N' ) SELECT /* kr.or.kids.domain.cm.community.dashboard.mapper.selectInstUldStats */ I.inst_nm AS instName , COALESCE(SUM(H.uld_nocs), 0) AS uldNocs , ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(H.err_rt, 0) / 100.0 * COALESCE(H.uld_nocs, 0))) AS errNocs , ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(H.err_rt, 0) * COALESCE(H.uld_nocs, 0)) / NULLIF(SUM(H.uld_nocs), 0), 2) AS errRt , MAX(P.last_updt_ymd) AS lastUpdtYmd FROM kids_own.tb_cm_m_uld_prst P JOIN LATEST_PBLNT L ON P.pblnt_sn = L.pblnt_sn JOIN kids_own.tb_pp_m_inst I ON I.brno = P.inst_id AND I.del_yn = 'N' LEFT JOIN kids_own.tb_cm_e_tbl_uld_stats_hist H ON H.ptcp_inst_sn = P.ptcp_inst_sn AND H.pblnt_sn = L.pblnt_sn AND H.del_yn = 'N' WHERE P.del_yn = 'N' GROUP BY I.inst_nm HAVING COALESCE(SUM(H.uld_nocs), 0) > 0 ORDER BY I.inst_nm

SELECT /* kr.or.kids.domain.cm.community.dashboard.mapper.selectInstUldNocs */ P.inst_id AS instId , I.inst_nm AS instName , COALESCE(SUM(H.uld_nocs), 0) AS uldNocs , MAX(P.last_updt_ymd) AS lastUpdtYmd FROM ( -- 기관별 최신 공시 1건만 추출 (tb_cm_m_uld_pblnt 기준) SELECT DISTINCT ON (P.inst_id) P.ptcp_inst_sn , P.pblnt_sn , P.inst_id , P.last_updt_ymd FROM kids_own.tb_cm_m_uld_prst P JOIN kids_own.tb_cm_m_uld_pblnt PB ON PB.pblnt_sn = P.pblnt_sn AND PB.del_yn = 'N' WHERE P.del_yn = 'N' ORDER BY P.inst_id, P.pblnt_sn DESC ) P JOIN kids_own.tb_pp_m_inst I ON P.inst_id = I.brno AND I.del_yn = 'N' LEFT JOIN kids_own.tb_cm_e_tbl_uld_stats_hist H ON H.ptcp_inst_sn = P.ptcp_inst_sn AND H.pblnt_sn = P.pblnt_sn AND H.del_yn = 'N' GROUP BY P.inst_id, I.inst_nm ORDER BY P.inst_id

WITH LATEST_PBLNT AS ( SELECT P.inst_id , MAX(PB.pblnt_sn) AS pblnt_sn FROM kids_own.tb_cm_m_uld_pblnt PB JOIN kids_own.tb_cm_m_uld_prst P ON P.pblnt_sn = PB.pblnt_sn AND P.del_yn = 'N' WHERE PB.del_yn = 'N' GROUP BY P.inst_id ) SELECT /* kr.or.kids.domain.cm.community.dashboard.mapper.selectInstErrRate */ P.inst_id AS instId , I.inst_nm AS instName , ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(H.err_rt, 0) / 100.0 * COALESCE(H.uld_nocs, 0))) AS errNocs , ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(H.err_rt, 0) * COALESCE(H.uld_nocs, 0)) / NULLIF(SUM(H.uld_nocs), 0), 2) AS errRt FROM kids_own.tb_cm_m_uld_prst P JOIN LATEST_PBLNT L ON P.inst_id = L.inst_id AND P.pblnt_sn = L.pblnt_sn JOIN kids_own.tb_pp_m_inst I ON P.inst_id = I.brno AND I.del_yn = 'N' LEFT JOIN kids_own.tb_cm_e_tbl_uld_stats_hist H ON P.ptcp_inst_sn = H.ptcp_inst_sn AND H.pblnt_sn = L.pblnt_sn AND H.del_yn = 'N' WHERE P.del_yn = 'N' GROUP BY P.inst_id, I.inst_nm ORDER BY errRt DESC

SELECT /* kr.or.kids.domain.cm.community.dashboard.mapper.selectInstAsmtPrtcpStats */ COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ptcp_prgrs_stts_cd NOT IN ('02', '12')) AS totalCnt, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ptcp_prgrs_stts_cd = '01') AS reqCnt,
-- 기관분석 COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ptcp_prgrs_stts_cd = '04') AS instProgressCnt, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ptcp_prgrs_stts_cd = '05') AS instReviewReqCnt, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ptcp_prgrs_stts_cd IN ('06', '07', '08')) AS instReviewCompleteCnt,
-- 메타분석 COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ptcp_prgrs_stts_cd = '09') AS metaReviewReqCnt, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ptcp_prgrs_stts_cd IN ('10', '13')) AS metaReviewCompleteCnt,
-- 마감 COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ptcp_prgrs_stts_cd = '11') AS closeCnt FROM kids_own.tb_cm_m_asmt_prcp WHERE del_yn = 'N' AND inst_id = #{instId}

SELECT /* kr.or.kids.domain.cm.community.dashboard.mapper.selectTbCmMAsmtByInst */ COUNT(*) AS totalCnt -- 총계 , COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN A.asmt_prgrs_stts_cd = '01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS reqCnt -- 등록(참여요청) , COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN A.asmt_prgrs_stts_cd = '02' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS progressCnt -- 진행중 , COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN A.asmt_prgrs_stts_cd = '03' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS reviewCnt -- 검토중 , COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN A.asmt_prgrs_stts_cd = '04' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS closeCnt -- 마감 , COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN A.asmt_prgrs_stts_cd = '05' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS cancelCnt -- 취소 FROM kids_own.tb_cm_m_asmt A WHERE A.del_yn = 'N' AND A.inst_id = #{instId}

SELECT /* kr.or.kids.domain.cm.community.dashboard.mapper.selectTblUldStats */ CASE WHEN T.trsf_se_cd = '01' THEN 'Sentinel' WHEN T.trsf_se_cd = '02' THEN 'OMOP' ELSE 'ETC' END AS modelType , T.err_tbl_nm AS tableName , COALESCE(T.uld_nocs, 0) AS uldNocs , COALESCE(T.err_rt, 0) AS errRt FROM kids_own.tb_cm_m_uld_pblnt pblnt INNER JOIN kids_own.tb_cm_m_uld_prst prst ON pblnt.pblnt_sn = prst.pblnt_sn AND (prst.del_yn IS NULL OR prst.del_yn = 'N') AND prst.inst_id IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(prst.inst_id) != '' AND LPAD(TRIM(prst.inst_id), 10, '0') = LPAD(TRIM(#{instId}), 10, '0') AND prst.pblnt_sn = ( SELECT MAX(pblnt_sn) FROM kids_own.tb_cm_m_uld_prst WHERE LPAD(TRIM(inst_id), 10, '0') = LPAD(TRIM(#{instId}), 10, '0') AND (del_yn IS NULL OR del_yn = 'N') ) INNER JOIN kids_own.tb_cm_e_tbl_uld_stats_hist T ON T.pblnt_sn = prst.pblnt_sn AND T.ptcp_inst_sn = prst.ptcp_inst_sn AND T.del_yn = 'N' WHERE (pblnt.del_yn IS NULL OR pblnt.del_yn = 'N') ORDER BY T.trsf_se_cd, T.err_tbl_nm

SELECT /* kr.or.kids.domain.cm.community.dashboard.mapper.selectInstTblUldNocsByModel */ T.err_tbl_nm AS tableName , COALESCE(SUM(T.uld_nocs), 0) AS uldNocs FROM kids_own.tb_cm_e_tbl_uld_stats_hist T JOIN kids_own.tb_cm_m_uld_prst P ON T.pblnt_sn = P.pblnt_sn AND T.ptcp_inst_sn = P.ptcp_inst_sn WHERE T.del_yn = 'N' AND P.del_yn = 'N' AND P.ptcp_inst_sn = #{ptcpInstSn} AND T.trsf_se_cd = #{trsfSeCd} GROUP BY T.err_tbl_nm ORDER BY uldNocs DESC

SELECT /* kr.or.kids.domain.cm.community.dashboard.mapper.selectInstCdmOverview */ D.tbl_se_cd AS tableType , COALESCE(SUM(D.tnocs), 0) AS totalNocs , MIN(D.bgng_ymd) AS minDate , MAX(D.end_ymd) AS maxDate , M.ver_info_nm AS cdmVersion , M.updt_cycle_cnt AS updateCycle , MIN(M.ptcp_reg_dt) AS regDt , MAX(M.last_updt_ymd) AS lastUpdtYmd FROM kids_own.tb_cm_d_uld_prd_scl D JOIN kids_own.tb_cm_m_uld_prst M ON D.ptcp_inst_sn = M.ptcp_inst_sn AND D.pblnt_sn = M.pblnt_sn WHERE D.del_yn = 'N' AND M.del_yn = 'N' AND D.ptcp_inst_sn = #{ptcpInstSn} AND D.pblnt_sn = ( SELECT MAX(pblnt_sn) FROM kids_own.tb_cm_m_uld_prst WHERE ptcp_inst_sn = #{ptcpInstSn} AND del_yn = 'N' ) GROUP BY D.tbl_se_cd , M.ver_info_nm , M.updt_cycle_cnt ORDER BY D.tbl_se_cd

SELECT /* kr.or.kids.domain.cm.community.dashboard.mapper.selectInstErrorSummary */ COALESCE(SUM(T.uld_nocs), 0) AS uldNocs , ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(T.err_rt, 0) * COALESCE(T.uld_nocs, 0)) / NULLIF(SUM(T.uld_nocs), 0), 2) AS errRt , MAX(prst.last_updt_ymd) AS lastUldDt FROM kids_own.tb_cm_m_uld_pblnt pblnt INNER JOIN kids_own.tb_cm_m_uld_prst prst ON pblnt.pblnt_sn = prst.pblnt_sn AND (prst.del_yn IS NULL OR prst.del_yn = 'N') AND prst.inst_id IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(prst.inst_id) != '' AND LPAD(TRIM(prst.inst_id), 10, '0') = LPAD(TRIM(#{instId}), 10, '0') AND prst.pblnt_sn = ( SELECT MAX(pblnt_sn) FROM kids_own.tb_cm_m_uld_prst WHERE LPAD(TRIM(inst_id), 10, '0') = LPAD(TRIM(#{instId}), 10, '0') AND (del_yn IS NULL OR del_yn = 'N') ) INNER JOIN kids_own.tb_cm_e_tbl_uld_stats_hist T ON T.pblnt_sn = prst.pblnt_sn AND T.ptcp_inst_sn = prst.ptcp_inst_sn AND T.del_yn = 'N' WHERE (pblnt.del_yn IS NULL OR pblnt.del_yn = 'N')

SELECT /* kr.or.kids.domain.cm.community.dashboard.mapper.selectInstUldPrgrStats */ COUNT(*) AS totalCnt , COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE prst.uld_inst_prgrs_stts_cd = '01') AS reqCnt -- 참여요청 , COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE prst.uld_inst_prgrs_stts_cd = '02') AS progressCnt -- 진행중 , COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE prst.uld_inst_prgrs_stts_cd = '03') AS completeCnt -- 완료 , COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE prst.uld_inst_prgrs_stts_cd = '04') AS cancelCnt -- 참여취소 , COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE prst.uld_inst_prgrs_stts_cd = '05') AS regCnt -- 등록 , COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE prst.uld_inst_prgrs_stts_cd = '06') AS reReqCnt -- 참여재요청 , COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE prst.uld_inst_prgrs_stts_cd = '07') AS reRegCnt -- 등록재요청 FROM kids_own.tb_cm_m_uld_prst prst JOIN kids_own.tb_cm_m_uld_pblnt pblnt ON prst.pblnt_sn = pblnt.pblnt_sn WHERE prst.del_yn = 'N' AND pblnt.del_yn = 'N' AND prst.inst_id = #{instId}

SELECT /* kr.or.kids.domain.cm.community.dashboard.mapper.selectDashboardInstUploadList */ i.brno AS instId , i.inst_nm AS instName , u.ptcp_inst_sn AS ptcpInstSn , u.pblnt_sn AS pblntSn , u.last_updt_ymd AS lastUpdtYmd , u.updt_cycle_cnt AS updateCycle , u.ver_info_nm AS cdmVersion FROM ( -- 기관별 최신 공시 1건만 추출 (selectTblUldStats와 동일 기준) SELECT DISTINCT ON (inst_id) ptcp_inst_sn , pblnt_sn , inst_id , last_updt_ymd , updt_cycle_cnt , ver_info_nm FROM kids_own.tb_cm_m_uld_prst WHERE del_yn = 'N' ORDER BY inst_id, pblnt_sn DESC, last_updt_ymd DESC ) u JOIN kids_own.tb_pp_m_inst i ON i.brno = u.inst_id AND i.del_yn = 'N' ORDER BY i.inst_nm;
